title: Earth - 2D Isometric Life Simulator
author: AIDevJosh
selftext:
[Earth - 2D Isometric Life Simulator](https://reddit.com/link/1wy0xgg/video/udtedukw7lth1/player)

**Hello,**

This is a game I've been 'vibe-coding' with Claude and ChatGPT side-by-side for roughly a week. It's a long-term hobby project. There are bugs in that video, and it's far from being complete, but gives those interested an insight into my envision for Earth. (Harbourvale is a place-holder name)

It currently leans on a fictitious life simulation based in Aotearoa New Zealand, however, the country/environment theme may change. Art was produced by Claude using Blender, however, at a later stage this will be replaced with 2D isometric art done by a proper artist.

I am Autistic, a Bachelor in IT student (almost in 2nd year) with 3 prior IT qualifications, and my interest highly aligns with Cyber Security. This life sim idea I have had since I was 15. I wanted to build something in-depth, but also something that had a purpose behind it. The ability to see how actions in-game have positive and/or negative consequences, and referencing the same decision choices in reality before pursuing them.

The video above was generated using a Canva plugin on Astra High.

***Thanks for watching and reading! ❤️***
